title: Tokyo Named World's Fourth Safest City to Visit
paragraphs: Tokyo is one of the world's safest cities to visit, according to a new ranking. Tokyo climbed up from ninth place last year to come fourth on this year's list, which ranks the world's safest cities for travelers in 2027.

Created by American travel insurance company Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection, the ranking looked at 38 of the most popular cities with US travelers. The company surveyed 1,500 travelers, and asked them to rank the cities for different aspects of safety, such as safety from crime and terrorism, health safety, transportation safety, and safety for women and minorities.
The survey results were then combined with safety rankings from The Economist and online database Numbeo, as well as scores from travel safety site GeoSure.
Among participants in the Berkshire Hathaway survey, this year Tokyo was ranked second in the world for transportation safety — and with its famously well-run trains, that's little surprise!

The city was also third globally for safety from violent crime, and GeoSure gave it a very high score for safety at night. However, it got lower survey scores for safety from terrorism and safety for women and minorities.
The world's safest city to visit in 2027 is Montreal, Canada.

Survey participants put Montreal first in the world for safety for women and minorities. It was second for safety from violent crime and terrorism, second for health safety, and third for transportation safety.

After Montreal was Zurich, Switzerland. Few survey participants had actually been there, but those who had visited gave it top scores for safety from violent crime and terrorism, and also for transportation and health safety.

Amsterdam in the Netherlands came third. Berkshire Hathaway suggested that Amsterdam's relaxed attractions — such as walking around canals and seeing art — help to make it an especially safe place to visit.
